titulo.alumno:
«Хотел сделать или хотел делать»
Intention and aspect

intro: Хотел прочитать книгу can mean he wanted to finish it; хотел читать highlights the wish to read as an activity.

piezas.titulo: Хотел прочитать книгу can mean he wanted to finish it; хотел читать highlights the wish to read as an activity.
texto: Хотел прочитать книгу can mean he wanted to finish it; хотел читать highlights the wish to read as an activity.
In the past, the verb хотел carries the tense and the infinitive contributes the contrast of aspect and meaning.

frases.estudio: Я хотел посмотреть фильм до конца.
frases.alumno: I wanted to watch the film to the end.

frases.estudio: В детстве он хотел стать архитектором.
frases.alumno: As a child he wanted to be an architect.

pregunta.texto: Which sentence focuses on a goal of finishing the film?

opciones.explicacion: Посмотреть presents watching as a desired complete result.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Я хотел посмотреть фильм до конца.»

frase.texto: Я хотел посмотреть фильм до конца.

opciones.texto: I wanted to watch the film to the end.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: As a child he wanted to be an architect.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: В детстве он хотел стать архитектором

piezas.traduccion: As a child he wanted to be an architect.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
